clean_description: The Devotion of Suspect X follows Yasuko Hanaoka, a single mother who kills her abusive ex-husband in self-defense. Her neighbor, Ishigami, a mathematics teacher, helps her cover up the crime, leading to a complex investigation by Detective Kusanagi and his friend, physicist Yukawa. The story unfolds as a battle of wits between Ishigami and Yukawa, who seeks to uncover the truth behind the murder.
